title: Uniform expectation equals finite average
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. The expectation of $f$ under the uniform probability distribution on $\Omega$ equals its uniform average, $\frac{1}{|\Omega|}\sum_{x\in\Omega}f(x)$.
